segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ، وَاقْضِ حَاجَتِي
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma fa-á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Älihi, waqá¸i á¸¥Äjati
segments.translation: O Allah, so bless Muhammad and his family, and fulfill my need.

segments.arabic: وَاسْمَعْ دُعَائِي، وَاسْتَجِبْ نِدَائِي، وَلَا تَخَيَّبْ رَجَائِي
segments.transliteration: WasmaÊ¿ duÊ¿ÄÊ¾Ä«, wa-stajib nidÄÊ¾Ä«, wa-lÄ tukhaayyib rajÄÊ¾Ä«
segments.translation: Hear my supplication, answer my call, and do not disappoint my hope.

segments.arabic: وَكُنْ لِي فِي جَمِيعِ أُمُورِي وَلِيًّا وَحَافِظًا وَمُعِينًا
segments.transliteration: Wa-kun lÄ« fÄ« jamÄ«Ê¿i umÅ«rÄ« waliyyan wa-á¸¥Äfiáºan wa-muÊ¿Ä«nan
segments.translation: And be for me in all my affairs a Guardian, Protector, and Helper.

segments.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً لَا انْقِطَاعَ لَهَا
segments.transliteration: Wa-á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Älihi á¹£alÄtan dÄÊ¾imatan lÄ inqiá¹­ÄÊ¿a lahÄ
segments.translation: And send blessings upon Muhammad and his familyâblessings everlasting, never ending.

segments.arabic: وَلَا غَايَةَ لِأَمَدِهَا، وَلَا نِهَايَةَ لِعَدَدِهَا
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ ghÄyata li-amadihÄ, wa-lÄ nihÄyata li-Ê¿adadihÄ
segments.translation: With no limit to their duration, and no end to their number.
1.O God, O ultimate object of needs!
2.O He through whom requests are attained!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا يَبِيْعُ نِعَمَهُ بالأثْمَانِ
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa yabeeu' nia'mahoo bil-ath-maan
segments.translation: 3.O He whose favours are not bought by prices!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُكَدِّرُ عَطَايَاهُ بِالامْتِنَانِ
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa yukad-diru a't'aayaahoo biiam-tinaan
segments.translation: 4.O He who does not muddy His gifts by the imposition of obligations!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُسْتَغْنَى بِهِ وَلاَ يُسْتَغْنَى عَنْهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yaa may-yus-tagh-naa bihee wa laa yus-tagh-naa a'n-h
segments.translation: 5.O He along with whom nothing is needed and without whom nothing can be done!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُرْغَبُ إلَيْهِ وَلا يُرْغَبُ عَنْهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa yaa may-yur-ghabu ilay-hee wa laa yur-ghabu a'n-h
segments.translation: 6.O He toward whom desire is ever directed and never turned away!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا تُفنى خَزَآئِنَهُ الْمَسَائِلُ
segments.translation: 7.O He whose treasuries cannot be exhausted by demands!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تُبَدِّلُ حِكْمَتَهُ الْوَسَائِلُ.
segments.translation: 8.O He whose wisdom cannot be altered by any means!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهُ حَوَائِجُ الْمُحْتَاجِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa tanqat'iu' a'n-hoo h'awaaa-ijul-muh'-taajeen
segments.translation: 9.O He from whom the needs of the needy are never cut off!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُعَنِّيهِ دُعَاءُ الدَّاعِينَ
segments.translation: 10.O He who is not distressed by the supplications of the supplicators!

segments.arabic: تَمَدَّحْتَ بِالْغَنَاءِ  عَنْ خَلْقِكَ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْغِنَى عَنْهُمْ
segments.transliteration: tamad-dah'-ta bil-ghanaaa-i a'n khal-qik wa anta ah-lul-ghinaa a'n-hum-
segments.translation: 11.You hast lauded Yourself for having no need for Your creatures, and it suits You to have no need for them,

segments.arabic: وَنَسَبْتَهُمْ إلَى الفَقْرِ وَهُمْ أَهْلُ الْفَقْرِ إلَيْكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa nasab-tahum ilaal-faq-r wa hum ah-lul-faq-ri ilay-k
segments.translation: 12.and You hast attributed to them poverty, and it suits them to be poor toward You.

segments.arabic: فَمَنْ حَاوَلَ سَدَّ خَلَّتِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
segments.transliteration: faman h'aawala sad-da khal-latihee min i'ndik
segments.translation: 13.So he who strives to remedy his lack through what is with You

segments.arabic: وَرَامَ صَرْفَ الْفَقْر عَنْ نَفْسِهِ بِكَ فَقَدْ طَلَبَ حَاجَتَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa raama s'ar-fal-faq-ri a'n-naf-sihee bik faqad t'alaba h'aajatahoo
segments.translation: 14.and wishes to turn poverty away from himself through You has sought his need

segments.arabic: فِي مَظَانِّها وَأَتَى طَلِبَتَهُ مِنْ وَجْهِهَا
segments.transliteration: fee? maz'aaan-nihaa wa ataa t'ilabatahoo miw-waj-hihaa
segments.translation: 15.in the most likely place and come to his request from the right quarter.

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ تَوَجَّهَ بِحَاجَتِهِ إلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَوْ جَعَلَهُ سَبَبَ نُجْحِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa man tawj-jaha bih'aajatiheee ilaaa ah'adim-min khal-qika aw jaa'lahoo sababa nuj-h'ihaa
segments.translation: 16.But he who turns in his need toward one of Your creatures or assigns the cause of its being granted
17.to other than You, has exposed himself to deprivation
18.and deserves to miss Your beneficence.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَلِي إلَيْكَ حَاجَةٌ قَـدْ قَصَّرَ عَنْهَـا جُهْدِي
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa leee ilay-ka h'aajah qad qas'-s'ara a'n-haa juh-dee
segments.translation: 19.O God, I have a need of You: my exertion has fallen short of it
20.and my stratagems have been cut back before reaching it.

segments.arabic: وَسَوَّلَتْ لِيْ نَفْسِي رَفْعَهَا إلَى مَنْ يَرْفَعُ حَوَائِجَهُ إلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa saw-walat lee naf-see raf-a'haaa ilaa may-yar-fau' h'awaaa-ijahooo ilay-ka
segments.translation: 21.My soul induced me to present it to him who presents his needs to You

segments.transliteration: wa laa yas-tagh-nee fee t'alibaatihee a'nka
segments.translation: 22.and can do nothing without You in his requests,
23.but this is one the slips of the offenders,
24.one of the stumbles of the sinners!

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ انْتَبَهْتُ بِتَذْكِيرِكَ لِي مِنْ غَفْلَتِي
segments.transliteration: thum-ma antabah-tu bitad'-keerika lee min ghaf-latee
segments.translation: 25.Then through Your reminding me, I was aroused from my heedlessness,
26.through Your giving success, I stood up from my slip,

segments.arabic: وَ رَجَعتُ وَنَكَصْتُ بِتَسْـدِيدِكَ عَنْ عَثْـرَتِي
segments.transliteration: wa rajaa'-tu wa  nakas'-tu bitas-deedika a'n a'th-ratee
segments.translation: 27.and through Your pointing the way, I returned and withdrew from my stumble.

segments.arabic: وَقُلْتُ: سُبْحَانَ رَبّي كَيْفَ يَسْأَلُ مُحْتَاجٌ مُحْتَاجـاً
segments.transliteration: wa qul-tu: sub-h'aana rab-bee kay-fa yas-alu muh'-taajum-muh'-taajaa?
segments.translation: 28.I said: Glory be to my Lord! How can the needy ask from the needy?

segments.transliteration: wa an-naa yarghabu mua'-dimun ilaa mua'-dimin?
segments.translation: 29.How can the destitute beseech the destitute?
30.So I went straight to You, my God, in beseeching,

segments.transliteration: wa aw-fat-tu a'lay-ka rajaaa-ee bith-thiqati bik
segments.translation: 31.and I sent You my hope with trust in You.

segments.arabic: وَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّ كَثِيرَ مَا أَسْأَلُكَ يَسِيرٌ فِي وُجْدِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa a'lim-tu an-na katheera maaa as-aluka yaseerun fee wuj-dik
segments.translation: 32.I came to know that the many I request from You are few before Your wealth,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ خَطِيرَ مَا أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ حَقِيرٌ فِيْ وُسْعِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa an-na khat'eera maaa as-taw-hibuka h'aqeerun fee wus-i'k
segments.translation: 33.the weighty I ask from You is vile before Your plenty;

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ كَرَمَكَ لاَ يَضِيقُ عَنْ سُؤَال أحَد
segments.transliteration: wa an-na karamaka laa yaz''eequ a'n soo-aali ah'ad
segments.translation: 34.Your generosity is not constrained by anyone's asking,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ يَدَكَ بِالْعَطايا أَعْلَى مِنْ كُلِّ يَد.
segments.transliteration: wa an-na yadaka bil-a't'aayaaa aa'-laa min kul-li yad
segments.translation: 35.Your hand is higher in bestowing gifts than every hand!

segments.arabic: أللَهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاحْمِلْنِي بِكَرَمِكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih wa ah'-mil-nee bikaramika a'laat-tafaz''-z''ul
segments.translation: 36.O God, so bless Muhammad and His Household, take me through their generosity to Your gratuitous bounty
37.And take me not through Your justice to what I deserve!

segments.arabic: فَما أَنَا بِأَوَّلِ رَاغِبِ رَغِبَ إلَيْكَ فَأَعْطَيْتَهُ وَهُوَ يَسْتَحِقُّ الْمَنْعَ
segments.transliteration: famaaa ana biw-wali raaghibir-raghiba ilay-ka faaa'-t'ay-tahoo wa huwa yas-tah'iq-qul-man-a'-
segments.translation: 38.I am not the first beseecher to beseech You and You bestowed upon him while he deserved withholding,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ بِأَوَّلِ سَائِل سَأَلَكَ فَأَفْضَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَسْتَوْجِبُ الْحِرْمَانَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa biw-wali saaa-ilin saalaka faaf-z''al-ta a'lay-hee wa huwa yas-taw-jibul-h'ir-maan
segments.translation: 39.nor am I the first to ask from You and Your vast bounteous toward him while he merited deprivation.
40.O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَكُنْ لِدُعَائِي مُجِيباً وَمِنْ نِدائِي قَرِيباً
segments.transliteration: wa kul-lidua'aa-ee mujeebaa wa min-nidaaa-ee qareebaa
segments.translation: 41.respond to my supplication, come near my call,

segments.transliteration: wa litaz''ar-rue'e raah'imaa wa lis'aw-tee saamia'a
segments.translation: 42.have mercy on my pleading, listen to my voice,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ رَجَائِي عَنْكَ وَلا تَبُتَّ سَبَبِي مِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laa taq-t'aa' rajaaa-ee a'nk wa laa tabut-ta sababee mink
segments.translation: 43.cut not short my hope for You, sever not my thread to You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُوَجِّهْنِي فِي حَاجَتيْ هَذِهِ وَغَيْرِهَا إلى سِوَاكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laa tuwaj-jih-nee fee h'aajatee hd'ihee waghay-rihaaa ilaa siwaak
segments.translation: 44.turn not my face in this my need, and other needs, away from You,

segments.transliteration: wa tawal-lanee binuj-hee t'alibatee wa qaz''aaa-i h'aajatee
segments.translation: 45.attend for my sake to the fulfillment of my request, the granting of my need,

segments.arabic: وَنَيْلِ سُؤْلِي قَبْلَ زَوَالِي عَنْ مَوْقِفِي هَذَا
segments.transliteration: wa nay-li soo-lee qab-la zawaalee a'm-maw-qifee had'aa
segments.translation: 46.and the attainment of what I have asked before I leave this place

segments.arabic: بِتَيسِيرِكَ لِيَ الْعَسِيْرَ وَحُسْنِ تَقْدِيرِكَ لِي فِي جَمِيعِ الأُمُورِ.
segments.transliteration: bitay-seerika leeal-a'seer wa h'us-ni taq-deerika lee fee jameei'l-umoor
segments.translation: 47.through Your making easy for me the difficult and Your excellent ordainment for me in all affairs!

segments.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ صَلاَةً دَائِمَةً نَامِيَةً لاَ انْقِطَاعَ لأِبَدِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih s'alaatan daaa-imatan-naameeah laa anqit'aaa' liabadihaa
segments.translation: 48.Bless Muhammad and his Household with a permanent, ever-growing blessing, whose perpetuity has no cutting off

segments.arabic: وَلا مُنْتَهَى لأِمَدِهَا وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ عَوْناً لِيْ وَسَبَباً لِنَجَاحِ طَلِبَتِي إنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيْمٌ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa muntahaa liamadihaa waj-a'l d'alika a'w-nal-lee wa sababal-linajaahee t'alibatee in-naka waasiu'n kareem
segments.translation: 49.and whose term knows no limit, and make that a help to me and a cause for the granting of my request! You art Boundless, Generous!

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ حَاجَتِي يَا رَبِّ كَذَا وَكَذَا
segments.transliteration: wa min h'aajatee yaa rab-bi kad'aa wakad'aa
segments.translation: 50.And of my needs,my Lord, are such and such

segments.arabic: وَتَذْكُرُ حَاجَتَكَ ثمّ تَسْجُـدُ وَتَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِكَ:
segments.translation: .Your bounty has comforted me and Your beneficence has shown the way,

segments.transliteration: faas-aluka bika wa bimuh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee s'alawaatuka a'lay-him al-laa tarud-danee khaaa-ibaa
segments.translation: .So I ask You by You and by Muhammad and his Household (Your blessings be upon them) that You sendest me not back in disappointment!

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَبِمُحَمَّـد وَآلِهِ صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهمْ أَنْ لاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi,
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muá¸¥ammad and his family,

segments.arabic: وَقِنَا مِنْكَ، وَاحْفَظْنَا بِكَ، وَاهْدِنَا إِلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa qinÄ minka, waá¸¥faáºnÄ bika, wa ahdinÄ ilayka,

segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ tubÄÊ¿idnÄ Ê¿anka inna man taqÄ«hi yaslamu,

segments.transliteration: Wa man tahdihi yaÊ¿lamu, wa man tuqarribuhu ilayka yaghnamu.
segments.translation: And whoever You guide knows, and whoever You bring near to You profits.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings on Muá¸¥ammad and his family,
And protect us from the calamities of time,

segments.arabic: وَشَرَّ مَصَائِدِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَمَرَارَةَ صَوْلَةِ السُّلْطَانِ.
segments.transliteration: Wa sharra maá¹£ÄÊ¾idi ash-shayá¹­Än wa marÄrata á¹£awlatis-sulá¹­Än.
segments.translation: And the evil traps of Satan and the bitterness of the rulerâs oppression.

segments.translation: O Allah, indeed, those who suffice suffice only by the grace

segments.transliteration: Quwwatika faá¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi, wa akfinÄ,
segments.translation: Of Your strength. So bless Muá¸¥ammad and his family, and suffice us,

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا يُعْطِي الْمُعْطُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ جِدَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa innamÄ yuÊ¿á¹­Ä« al-muÊ¿á¹­Å«na min faá¸li jiddatika,
segments.translation: And indeed, those who give do so from the abundance of Your generosity,

segments.transliteration: Faá¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi wa aÊ¿á¹­inÄ,
segments.translation: So send blessings on Muá¸¥ammad and his family and grant us,

segments.transliteration: Wa innamÄ yahtadÄ« al-muhtadÅ«na bi nÅ«ri wajhika,
segments.translation: And indeed, those who are guided are guided by the light of Your Face,

segments.transliteration: Faá¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi wa ahdinÄ.
segments.translation: So send blessings on Muá¸¥ammad and his family and guide us.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ مَنْ وَلَّيْتَ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ خِذْلَانُ الْخَاذِلِينَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innaka man wallayta lam yaá¸urrhu khiá¸lÄnu al-khÄá¸ilÄ«n,
segments.translation: O Allah, surely whoever You befriend, the abandoning of the traitors harms him not,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَعْطَيْتَ لَمْ يَنْقُصْهُ مَنْعُ الْمَانِعِينَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa man aÊ¿á¹­ayta lam yanquá¹£hu manÊ¿u al-mÄniÊ¿Ä«n,
segments.translation: And whoever You grant, the denial of the deniers decreases him not,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ هَدَيْتَ لَمْ يُغْوِهِ إِضْلَالُ الْمُضِلِّينَ.
segments.transliteration: Wa man hadayta lam yughwihi iá¸lÄlu al-muá¸illÄ«n,
segments.translation: And whoever You guide, the misguidance of the misleaders misleads him not.

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ، وَامْنَعْنَا بِعِزَّكَ، مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segments.transliteration: Faá¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi, wa amnaÊ¿nÄ bi Ê¿izzika min Ê¿ibÄdika,
segments.translation: So send blessings on Muá¸¥ammad and his family, and protect us by Your glory from Your servants,

segments.transliteration: Wa aghninÄ Ê¿an ghayrika bi irfÄdika,
segments.translation: And enrich us besides anyone else by Your aid,

segments.transliteration: Wa asluk binÄ sabÄ«la al-á¸¥aqqi bi irshÄdika.
segments.translation: And guide us on the path of truth by Your guidance.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْ سَلاَمَةَ قُلُوبِنَا
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi wa-jÊ¿al salÄmata qulÅ«binÄ,
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings on Muá¸¥ammad and his family and make the safety of our hearts

segments.arabic: فِي ذِكْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَفَرَاغَ أَبْدَانِنَا فِي شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: FÄ« dhikri Ê¿aáºamatika wa farÄgha abdaninÄ fÄ« shukri niÊ¿matika,
segments.translation: In the remembrance of Your greatness and the emptiness of our bodies in gratitude for Your blessings,

segments.transliteration: Wa iná¹­ilÄqa alsinatinÄ fÄ« waá¹£fi minnatikÄ.
segments.translation: And the release of our tongues in praising Your favor.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings on Muá¸¥ammad and his family

segments.transliteration: Wa jÊ¿alnÄ min duÊ¿Ätika ad-dÄÊ¿Ä«n ilayka,
segments.translation: And make us among those who call to You,
And Your guides who lead to You,
And from Your chosen, the special ones near You,
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
1.O He the wonders of whose mightiness will never end!
2.Bless Muhammad and his Household
3.and prevent us from deviation concerning Your mightiness!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تَنْتَهِي مُدَّةُ مُلْكِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa tantahee mud-datu mul-kih
segments.translation: 4.O He the term of whose kingdom will never cease!
5.Bless Muhammad and his Household
6.and release our necks from Your vengeance!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا تَفْنَى خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa taf-naa khazaaa-inu rah'-matih
segments.translation: 7.O He the treasuries of whose mercy will never be exhausted!
8.Bless Muhammad and his Household
9.and appoint for us a portion of Your mercy!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ تَنْقَطِعُ دُونَ رُؤْيَتِهِ الابْصَارُ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man tanqat'iu' doona roo-yatihil-ab-s'aar
segments.translation: 10.O He whom eyes fall short of seeing!
11.Bless Muhammad and his Household
12.and bring us close to Your nearness!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ تَصْغُرُ عِنْدَ خَطَرِهِ الاخْطَارُ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man tas'-ghuru i'nda khat'arihil-akh-t'aar
segments.translation: 13.O He before whose greatness all great things are small!
14.Bless Muhammad and his Household
15.and give us honour with You!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ تَظْهَرُ عِنْدَهُ بَوَاطِنُ الاخْبَارِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man taz'-haru i'ndahoo bawaat'inul-akh-baar
segments.translation: 16.O He to whom all hidden tidings are manifest!
17.Bless Muhammad and his Household
18.and expose us not before You!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ هِبَةِ الْوَهّابِيْنَ بِهِبَتِكَ،
segments.translation: 19.O God, remove our need for the gifts of the givers through Your gift,
20.spare us the loneliness of those who break off through Your joining,

segments.arabic: حَتّى لا نَرْغَبَ إلَى أحَد مَعَ بَذْلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa laa nar-ghaba ilaaa ah'adim-maa' bad'-lik
segments.translation: 21.that we may beseech no one along with Your free giving,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ نَسْتَوْحِشَ مِنْ أحَد مَعَ فَضْلِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laa nas-taw-h'isha min ah'adim-ma'aa faz'-lik
segments.translation: 22.that we may feel lonely at no one's absence along with Your bounty!
23.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa kid lanaa wa laa takid a'lay-naa
segments.translation: 24.scheme for us, not against us,

segments.transliteration: wa am-kur lanaa wa laa tam-kur binaa
segments.translation: 25.devise to our benefit, not to our loss,

segments.transliteration: wa adil-lanaa wa laa tudil min-naa
segments.translation: 26.give the turn to prevail to us, not to others!
27.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَقِنَا مِنْكَ، وَاحْفَظْنَا بِكَ، وَاهْدِنَا إلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa qinaa mink wa ah'-faz'-naa bik wa ah-dinaaa ilay-k
segments.translation: 28.protect us from Yourself, safeguard us through Yourself, guide us to Yourself,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُبَاعِدْنَا عَنْكَ إنّ مَنْ تَقِهِ يَسْلَمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tubaai'd-naa a'nk in-na man taqihee yas-lam-
segments.translation: 29.and take us not far from Yourself! he whom You protectest stays safe,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ تَهْدِهِ يَعْلَمْ، وَمَنْ تُقَرِّبُهُ إلَيْكَ يَغْنَمْ.
segments.transliteration: wa man tah-dihee yaa'-lam- wa man tuqar-rib-hooo ilay-ka yagh-nam-
segments.translation: 30.he whom You guidest knows, and he whom You bringest near Yourself takes the spoils.
31.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
32.and spare us the cutting edge of time's turning changes,

segments.arabic: وَشَرَّ مَصَائِدِ الشّيطانِ وَمَرَارَةَ صَوْلَةِ السُّلْطَانِ.
segments.transliteration: wa shar-ra mas'aaa-idish-shay-t'aan wa maraarata s'aw-latis-sul-t'aan
segments.translation: 33.the evil of Satan's snares, and the bitterness of the sovereign's aggression!
34.O God, the spared are spared only through the bounty

segments.transliteration: qoo-watik fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wak-finaa
segments.translation: 35.of Your strength, so bless Muhammad and his Household, and spare us!

segments.arabic: وَإنَّمَا يُعْطِي الْمُعْطُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ جِدَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa in-namaa yua'-t'eel-mua'-t'oona min faz''-li jidatik
segments.translation: 36.The givers give only through the bounty of Your wealth,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ و اعطنا
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wa aa'-t'inaa
segments.translation: 37.so bless Muhammad and his Household and give to us!
38.The guided are guided only by the light of Your face,
39.so bless Muhammad and his Household and guide us!

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ إنّكَ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ لَمْ يَضْرُرْهُ خِذْلانُ الْخَاذِلِينَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-nak maw-waalay-ta lam yaz''-rur-hoo khid'-laanul-khaad'ileen
segments.translation: 40.O God, he whom You befriendest will not be injured by the abandonment of the abandoners,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أعْطَيْتَ لَمْ يَنْقُصْهُ مَنْـعُ الْمَانِعِينَ،
segments.transliteration: wa man aa'-t'ay-ta lam yanqus'-hoo man-u'l-maanie'en
segments.translation: 41.he to whom You givest will not be diminished by the withholding of the withholders,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ هَدَيْتَ لَمْ يُغْوِهِ إضْلاَلُ المُضِلِّيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: wa man haday-ta lam yugh-wiheee iz''-laalul-muz''il-leen
segments.translation: 42.he whom You guidest will not be misled by the misguidance of the misguiders.

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَامْنَعْنَا بِعِزَّكَ، مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih wa am-naa'-naa bii'z-zika min i'baadik
segments.translation: 43.So bless Muhammad and his Household, defend us from Your servants
44.through Your might, free us from need for other than You through Your support,
45.and make us travel the path of the Truth through Your right guidance!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاجْعَلْ سَلاَمَةَ قُلُوبِنَا
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih waj-a'l- salaamata quloobinaa
segments.translation: 46.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and put the soundness of our hearts

segments.arabic: فِي ذِكْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَفَرَاغَ أبْدَانِنَا فِي شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: fee d'ik-ri a'z'amatik wa faraagha ab-daaninaa fee shuk-ri nia'-matik
segments.translation: 47.into the remembrance of Your mightiness, the idleness of our bodies into giving thanks for Your favour,
48.and the flow of our tongues into the description of Your kindness!
49.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
50.and make us one of Your summoners who summon to You,
51.Your guiders who direct to You,
52.and Your special friends whom You hast singled out!
53.O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.translation: And whoever intends harm against me, turn it away from me

segments.translation: Repel his deceit from me and ward off his evil

And place a barrier before him

And deafen his hearing from my mention
And lock his heart from thinking of me
And silence his tongue regarding me

Indeed, You are Mighty and Powerful
1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa al-bis-nee a'afeeatak wa jal-lil-nee a'afeeatak
segments.translation: 2.clothe me in Your well-being, wrap me in Your well-being,

segments.transliteration: wa h'as'-s'in-nee bia'afeeatik wa ak-rim-nee bia'afeeatik
segments.translation: 3.fortify me through Your well-being, honour me with Your well-being,

segments.transliteration: wa agh-ninee bia'afeeatik wa tas'ad-daq a'lay-ya bia'afeeatik
segments.translation: 4.free me from need through Your well-being, donate to me Your well-being,

segments.transliteration: wa hab lee a'afeeatak wa af-rish-nee a'afeeatak
segments.translation: 5.bestow upon me Your well-being, spread out for me Your well-being,

segments.arabic: وَأَصْلِحْ لِي عَافِيَتَكَ، وَلا تُفَرِّقْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ عَافِيَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa as'-lih' lee a'afeeatak wa laa tufar-riq bay-nee wa bay-na a'afeeatika
segments.translation: 6.set Your well-being right for me, and separate me not from Your well-being
7.in this world and the next!
8.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَعَافِنِي عَافِيَةً كَافِيَةً شَافِيَةً عَالِيَةً نَامِيةً،
segments.transliteration: wa a'afinee a'afeeatan kaafeeatan shaafeeatan a'aleeatan-naameeah
segments.translation: 9.and make me well with a well-being sufficient, healing, sublime, growing,
10.a well-being that will give birth to well-being in my body,
11.a well-being in this world and the next!

segments.arabic: وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِالصِّحَّةِ وَالأمْنِ وَالسَّلاَمَةِ فِي دِيْنِي وَبَـدَنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa am-nun a'lay-ya bis'-s'ih'-h'ati wal-am-n was-salaamati fee deenee wa badanee
segments.translation: 12.Oblige me through health, security, and safety in my religion and body,

segments.arabic: وَالْبَصِيرَةِ فِي قَلْبِي وَالنَّفَاذِ فِي أمُورِيْ وَالْخَشْيَةِ لَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wal-bas'eerati fee qal-bee wan-nafaad'i feee umooree wal-khash-yati lak
segments.translation: 13.insight in my heart, penetration in my affairs, dread of You,

segments.arabic: وَالْخَوْفِ مِنْكَ وَالْقُوَّةِ عَلَى مَا أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wal-khaw-fi mink wa alqoo-wati a'laa maaa amar-tanee bihee min t'aaa'tik
segments.translation: 14.fear of You, strength for the obedience which You hast commanded for me,

segments.arabic: وَالاجْتِنَابِ لِمَـا نَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهُ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِـكَ.
segments.translation: 15.and avoidance of the disobedience which You hast prohibited for me!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa am-nun a'lay bil-h'aj-ji wal-u'm-rah
segments.translation: 16.O God, oblige me through the hajj, the umra,

segments.transliteration: wa zeeaarati qab-ri rasoolika s'alawaatuka a'lay-hee
segments.translation: 17.and visiting the graves of Your Messenger (Your blessings,
18.mercy, and benedictions upon him and upon his Household)

segments.arabic: وَآلِ رَسُولِكَ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ أَبَداً مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa a'laaa aaali rasoolika a'lay-himus-salaamu abadam-maaa ab-qay-tanee
segments.translation: 19.and the Household of Your Messenger (upon them be peace) for as long as You causest me to live,

segments.arabic: فِي عَامِي هَذَا وَفِي كُلِّ عَام،
segments.transliteration: fee a'amee had'aa wa fee kul-li a'am
segments.translation: 20.in this year of mine and in every year,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ مَقْبُولاً مَشْكُوراً مَذْكُوراً لَدَيْكَ،
segments.translation: 21.and make that accepted, thanked, and mentioned before You
22.and stored away with You!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْطِقْ بِحَمْدِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَذِكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ الثَّناءِ  عَلَيْكَ لِسَانِي،
segments.transliteration: wa ant'iq bih'am-dika washuk-rika wad'ik-rika wah'us-nith-thanaaa-i a'lay-ka lisaanee
segments.translation: 23.Make my tongue utter Your praise, Your thanksgiving, Your remembrance, and Your excellent laudation,
24.and expand my heart toward the right goals of Your religion!

segments.arabic: ÙÙØ£ÙØ¹ÙØ°ÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ°ÙØ±ÙÙÙÙÙØªÙÙ ÙÙÙÙ Ø§ÙØ´ÙÙÙÙØ·ÙØ§ÙÙ Ø§ÙØ±ÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙ
segments.translation: 25.Give me and my progeny refuge from the accursed Satan,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ السَّامَّةِ وَالْهَامَّةِ وَالْعَامَّةِ وَاللاَّمَّةِ
segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ris-saaam-mati wal-haaam-mati wal-a'aam-mati wal-l-laaam-mah
segments.translation: 26.the evil of venomous vermin, threatening pests, swarming crowds, and evil eyes,
27.the evil of "every rebel satan" (22:3),

segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li sul-t'aanin a'need
segments.translation: 28.the evil of every refractory sovereign,

segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li mut-rafin h'afeed
segments.translation: 29.the evil of everyone living in ease and served,

segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li z''ae'efiw-wa shadeed
segments.translation: 30.the evil of everyone weak or strong,

segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li shareefiw-wa waz''eea'
segments.translation: 31.the evil of everyone born high or low,

segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li s'agheeriw-wa kabeer
segments.translation: 32.the evil of everyone small or great,

segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li qareebiw-wa bae'ed
segments.translation: 33.the evil of everyone near or far,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ مَنْ نَصَبَ لِرَسُولِكَ وَلأهْلِ بَيْتِهِ حَرْبَـاً مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالإنْسِ،
segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li man-nas'aba lirasoolika waliah-li bay-tihee h'ar-bam-minal-jin-ni wal-ins
segments.translation: 34.the evil of every one, jinn or man, who declares war on Your Messenger and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرّ كُلِّ دَابَّة أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li daaab-batin anta aaakhid'um-binaas'eeatihaa
segments.translation: 35.and the evil of "every crawling creature that You hast taken by the forelock!
36.Surely You art on a straight path"(ref.11:56).
37.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَرَادَنِي بِسُوء فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَادْحَرْ عَنِّي مَكْرَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa man araadanee bisooo-in  faas'-rif-hoo a'n-nee wa ad-h'ar a'n-nee mak-rah
segments.translation: 38.and if someone desires ill for me turn him away from me, drive away from me his deception,

segments.arabic: وَادْرَأ عَنِّي شَرَّهُ، وَرُدَّ كَيْدَهُ فِي نَحْرِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa ad-raa a'n-nee shar-rah wa rud-da kay-dahoo fee nah'-rih
segments.translation: 39.avert from me his evil, send his trickery back to his own throat,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ سَدّاً حَتَّى تُعْمِيَ عَنِّي بَصَرَهُ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l bay-na yaday-hee sad-dana h'at-taa tua'-meea a'n-nee bas'arah
segments.translation: 40.and place before him a barricade, so that You mayest blind his eyes toward me,

segments.transliteration: wa tus'im-ma a'n d'ik-ree sam-a'h wa tuq-fila doona ikh-t'aaree qal-bah
segments.translation: 41.deafen his ears toward my mention, lock his heart toward recalling me,

segments.transliteration: wa tukh-risa a'n-nee lisaanah wa taq-maa' raa-sah
segments.translation: 42.silence his tongue against me, restrain his head,

segments.transliteration: wa tud'il-la i'z-zah wa tak-sira jabarootah
segments.translation: 43.abase his exaltation, break his arrogance,

segments.transliteration: wa tud'il-la raqabatah wa taf-sakha kib-rah
segments.translation: 44.abase his neck, disjoint his pride,
45.and make me secure from all his injury,

segments.transliteration: washar-rih wa gham-zihee wa ham-zihee wa lam-zih wa h'asadihee
segments.translation: 46.his evil, his slander, his backbiting, his faultfinding, his envy,

segments.transliteration: wa a'daawatih wa h'abaaa-ilihee wa mas'aaa-idih wa raj-lihee wakhay-lih
segments.translation: 47.his enmity, his snares, his traps, his foot soldiers, and his cavalry!
48.Surely You art Mighty, Powerful!

segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ٱلْحَلِيمُ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu al`azimu alhalimu
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah, the All-great and Most Forbearing.

segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيـمِ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu rabbu al`arshi alkarimu
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah, the Lord of the Throne of Honor.
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
O Allah, I ask You for the motives of Your mercy,
the determining causes of Your forgiveness,
the advantage of each act of kindness,
and the safeguarding against each and every sin.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَدَعْ لِي ذَنْباً إِلاَّ غَفَرْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma la tada` li dhanban illa ghafartahu
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) do not leave any of my offenses unforgiven,
any of my misfortunes unrelieved,
any of my ailments unhealed,
any of my defects uncovered,
any (item of my) sustenance not including (me),
any fear (that I experience) unsecured,
any evil (that comes upon me) uncontrollable,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَاجَةً هِيَ لَكَ رِضاً وَلِيَ فيهَا صَلاَحٌ إِلاَّ قَضَيْتَهَا
segments.transliteration: wa la hajatan hiya laka ridan wa liya fiha salahun illa qadaytaha
segments.translation: and any need that achieves Your satisfaction and my benefit unanswered.
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
(please) Respond, O Lord of the worlds.
With Allah I seek protection,
in Allah I trust,
and upon Allah I rely.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ عَظُمَتْ ذُنُوبِي فَأَنْتَ أَعْظَمُ
segments.translation: O Allah! if my sins are enormous, surely You are more Tremendous.

segments.transliteration: wa in kabura tafriti fa-anta akbaru
segments.translation: If my transgression has exceeded all limits, surely You are Greater.

segments.transliteration: wa in dama bukhli fa-anta ajwadu
segments.translation: If my stinginess has perpetuated, surely You are more Generous.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱغْفِرْ لِي عَظيمَ ذُنُوبِي بِعَظِيمِ عَفْوِكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) forgive my enormous sins out of Your tremendous pardon,
forgive my limitless transgression out of Your obvious generosity,
and impede my stinginess by the virtue of Your magnanimity.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَة فَمِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ma bina min ni`matin faminka
segments.translation: O Allah, You are certainly the source of each and every favor that covers us.
There is no god save You.
I pray Your forgiveness and I repent before You.

segments.arabic: اََللّهُمّ صَلّ عَلٰی مُحَمّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمّدٍ وَ عَجّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ.
segments.transliteration: Allahuma Inni Ataqqarabu Elaika B-Jodik Wa-Karamik,
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek closeness towards you through your goodness and generosity,

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اِنّي اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ بِجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa Ataqarabu Elaika B Mohammed Abdik Wa-Rasoolik,
segments.translation: and I closeness towards you through Muhammad; your servant and messenger,

segments.transliteration: Wa Ataqarabu Elaika B Malaikatik Al Moqarabeen Wa Anbiyaik Wa Rosolik,
segments.translation: and I seek closeness towards you through your closest most dearest angles, prophets and apostles;

segments.arabic: وَاَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ بِمَلائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبينَ وَاَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: An Tosali Ala Mohammed Abdik Wa Rasoolik Wa Ala Aali Mohammed,
segments.translation: That to send your blessings onto Muhammed your servant and messenger and onto Muhammadâs progeny,

segments.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّد عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ وَعَلى آلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.transliteration: Wa An Tqilni Asrati Wa-Tastor Ala Znoobi Wa Tagfirha Lee
segments.translation: That so you let go of what I have stumbled upon and that you cover my sins and you forgive them for me

segments.arabic: وَاْنَ تُقيلَني عَثْرَتي وَتَسْتُرَ عَلَيَّ ذُنُوبي وَتَغْفِرَها لي،
segments.transliteration: Wa Taqdi Lee Hawaeiji Wa La Toazbni B Qabeehin Kaan Min-ni
segments.translation: and  grant me my needs and  do not torment me due to the filth of what was done by me,

segments.arabic: وَتَقْضِيَ لي حَوائجي وَلا تُعَذِّبْني بِقَبيحٍ كانَ مِنّي،
segments.transliteration: Fa Inna Afwaka Wa Joodak Yasaoni
segments.translation: For your mercy and generosity suffices me
As you are capable to do all things
O Source of Piety and Forgiveness, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: يَا اَهْلَ التَّقْوٰى وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segments.translation: You are my Guardian and my Master, so provide for me.

segments.transliteration: Anta khayrun li min abi wa ummi wa minan-nasi ajmaâin
segments.translation: You are better for me than my father, my mother, and all of mankind.

segments.arabic: اَنْتَ خَيْرٌ لِيْ مِنْ اَبِيْ وَ اُمِّيْ وَ مِنَ النَّاسِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Bi ilayka faqrun wa faqah, wa anta ghaniyyun âanni
segments.translation: I am in state of poverty and need toward You, while You are free of any need for me.

segments.arabic: بِيْ اِلَيْكَ فَقْرٌ وَ فَاقَةٌ وَ اَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِّيْ
segments.translation: I ask You by Your Noble Countenance.

segments.transliteration: Wa as-aluka an tusalliya âala Muhammadin wa ali Muhammad
segments.translation: And I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُـحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: And upon his brothers among the Prophets and the purified Imams.

segments.arabic: وَ عَلٰى اِخْوَانِهِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ وَ الْاَئـِمَّةِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Wa tastajiba duâaâi wa tarhama tadarruâi
segments.translation: And that You answer my prayer and have mercy on my humble pleading.

segments.arabic: وَ تَسْتَجِيْبَ دُعَائِيْ وَ تَرْحَمَ تَضَرُّعِيْ
segments.translation: And turn away from me all types of affliction, O Most Gracious.

segments.arabic: وَ اصْرِفْ عَنِّيْ اَنْوَاعَ الْبَلَاءِ يَا رَحْمٰنُ
segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha alladhi la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: Â« O Allah, I draw near to You with Your generosity  and I draw near to You through Muhammad Your servant and Messenger, and I draw near to You with Your close angels, Your messenger prophets, and with You.

segments.arabic: « اللّهُمَّ ، إنِّي أَتَقَرَّبً إلَيَْكَ بِجُودِكَ ، وَكَرَمِكَ ، وَأَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ ، وَأَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِمَلَائِكَتِكَ المُقَرَّبِينَ ، وَأَنْبِيَائِكَ المُرْسَلِينَ ، وَبِكَ.
segments.translation: O God, You are the One who is needless of me, and I am in need of You, and You are the Rich, and I am poor.

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ ، أَنْتَ الغَنِّى عَنِّي ، وَبي الفَاقَةُ إلَيْكَ ، وَأَنْتَ الغَنِيُ ، وَأَنَا الفقيرُ
segments.translation: You have lifted me up from my stumble, and covered my sins, so fulfill my need today, and do not torture me due to what is ugly that you know of me, but your forgiveness and your presence are enough for me..  Â»

segments.arabic: إلَيْكَ أقلْتني مِنْ عَثْرَتي ، وَسَتَرْتَ عَلَيَّ ذُنُوبي ، فَاقْضِ اليَوْمَ حاجتي ، ولا تُعَذّبْني بِقَبِيحِ ما تَعْلَمُ مِنِّي ، بَلْ عَفْوُكَ وَجُودُكَ يَسَعُني .. »
segments.translation: "O people of piety, O people of forgiveness, O righteousness, O merciful, you are more honorable to me than my father, my mother, and all creatures. Accept me by fulfilling my needs and answering my supplications.â Have mercy on my voice, you have revealed all kinds of afflictions from me"

segments.arabic: « يا أَهْلَ التَقْوَى ، وَيَا أَهْلَ المَغْفِرَةِ ، يا بِرُّ يا رَحِيمُ ، أَنْتَ أَبرُّ بي مِنْ أَبي ، وَأُمِّي ، وَمِنْ جَمِيعِ الخَلَائِقِ ، إقْبَلْني بِقَضَاءِ حَاجَتي ، مُجَاباً دُعَائي ، مَرْحُوماً صَوْتي ، قَدْ كَشَفْتَ أَنْوَاعَ البَلَاءِ عَنِّي .. »
segments.translation: O' He who hear all voice, O' He who gathered every thing, O' He who created soul after death,

segments.arabic:
يا سامِعَ كُلِّ صَوْتٍ ،
 يا جامِعَ (كُلِّ فَوْتٍ) ،
 يا بارِئَ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ ،
segments.translation: O' the causer, O' the Inheritor, O' master of the masters, O' God of gods,

segments.arabic:
يا باعِثُ ،
 يا وارِثُ ،
 يا سَيِّدَ السَّادَةِ ،
 يا إِلهَ الْآلِهَةِ ،
segments.translation: O' The Mighty over the oppressors, O' The king of this world and the Hereafter,

segments.arabic:
يا جَبَّارَ الْجَبابِرَةِ ،
 يا مَلِكَ الدُّنْيا وَالْآخِرَةِ ،
segments.translation: O' the Lord of the lords, O' the King of the kings,

segments.arabic:
يا رَبَّ الْأَرْبابِ ،
 يا مَلِكَ الْمُلُوكِ
segments.transliteration: la yamliku linafsihi naf`an wa la darran
segments.translation: O' the vigorous, O' He who attain extreme vigorous, O' He who did what He wishes,

segments.arabic:
يا بَطَّاشُ ، يا ذَا الْبَطْشِ الشَّديدِ ،
 يا فَعَّالاً لِما يُريدُ ،
segments.transliteration: wa la mawtan wa la hayatan wa la nushuran
segments.translation: O' He who knows the number of breaths and movement of feet,

segments.arabic: يا مُحْصِيَ عَدَدِ الْأَنْفاسِ وَنَقْلِ الْأَقْدامِ ،
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min nafsin la tashba`u
segments.translation: O' He who to Him all secrets are visible, O' the starter, O' He who  returns every thing.

segments.arabic:
يا مَنِ السِّرُّ عِنْدَهُ عَلانِيَةٌ ،
 يا مُبْدِئُ ، يا مُعيدُ .
segments.translation: I requested from You by the sake of your right over the best among Your creatures and for the sake of their right you have made incumbent on Yourself

segments.arabic:
أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ عَلى خِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ، وَبِحَقِّهِمُ الَّذي أَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ عَلى نَفْسِكَ ،
I requested from You by the sake of your right over the best among Your creatures and for the sake of their right you have made incumbent on Yourself 
 أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلامُ ، وَأَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيَّ السَّاعَةَ السَّاعَةَ بِفِكاكِ رَقَبَتي مِنَ النَّارِ ، وَأَنْجِزْ لِوَلِيِّكَ وَابْنِ نَبِيِّكَ الدَّاعي إِلَيْكَ بِإِذْنِكَ ،
segments.translation: to send Your blessing on Muhammad and members of his house and to grant me the rescue of my neck from the Hell fire, execute for Your good friends from the descendant of Your Prophet, the callers to Your course with Your permission,

segments.arabic: وَأَمينِكَ في خَلْقِكَ ، وَعَيْنِكَ في عِبادِكَ ، وَحُجَّتِكَ عَلى خَلْقِكَ ، عَلَيْهِ صَلَواتُكَ وَبَرَكاتُكَ وَعْدَهُ .
segments.translation: Your trustee among Your creatures, Your sight among Your servants, Your proof among Your creatures, may Your peace and blessing be upon him.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ أَيِّدْهُ بِنَصْرِكَ ، وَانْصُرْ عَبْدَكَ ، وَقَوِّ أَصْحابَهُ وَصَبِّرْهُمْ ،
segments.translation: O' Allah! Support him with Your assistance and assist Your servant, empowered his companions and grant them patience

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطاناً نَصيراً ، وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُ ، وَأَمْكِنْهُ مِنْ أَعْدائِكَ وَأَعْداءِ رَسُولِكَ ، يا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمينَ .
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka alyusra ba`da al`usri
segments.translation: Open for them a protected authority and hasten his relief, let him prevail over Yours and Your Prophet's enemies, O' the Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
segments.translation: I pray the forgiveness of Allah; there is no god save Him,
the Ever-living, the Self-Subsisting,

segments.transliteration: allahumma ma bina min ni`matin faminka
segments.translation: the All-compassionate, the All-merciful,
and the Lord of Majesty and Honor.
And I ask Him to accept my repentance,
like His acceptance of the repentance of a slave who is submissive, acquiescent,

segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-alukatâtâayyibaati wa tarkal munkaraati wa fiâ-kak khayraati an taghfira lanaa wa tarhâamanaa wa tatooba aâlaynaa wa tawaffanaa ghayra maftoonin birahâmatika yaa arhâamar raahâimeen
segments.translation: poor, miserable,
despondent, dejected, seeking refuge (with Him),

segments.arabic: لاَ يَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِهِ نَفْعَاً وَلاَ ضَرّاً
segments.translation: not controlling for himself any harm or profit,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ مَوْتاً وَلاَ حَيَاةً وَلاَ نُشُوراً
segments.transliteration: ikhtim li fi yawmi hadha bikhayrin
segments.translation: and not controlling death nor life nor raising (the dead) to life.

segments.arabic:
ا
َللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَفْسٍ لاَ تَشْبَعُ
segments.translation: O Allah, I surely seek Your protection against a self that never has enough,
a heart that does not feel apprehension,
knowledge that does not avail,
a prayer that is not accepted,
and a supplication that is not responded.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ ٱلْيُسْرَ بَعْدَ ٱلْعُسْرِ
segments.translation: O Allah, I surely beseech You for easiness after difficulty,

segments.transliteration: Yaa man ghalabta fa 'azumta bi qudratika,
segments.translation: relief after misfortune,
and comfort after hardship.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنْكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, You are certainly the source of each and every favor that covers us.
There is no god save You.

segments.transliteration: Yaa man yantaqimu bi qudratihi min ahlil ilhaadi,
segments.translation: I pray Your forgiveness and repent before You.

segments.transliteration: As'aluka bihaqqi waliyyika 'Aliyyi bni Abi Talib,
segments.translation: Praise is for Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبَّ الْاَرَضِيْنَ السَّبْعِ وَ مَا فِيْهِنَّ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ وَ مَا تَحْتَهُنَّ وَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ
segments.transliteration: Wa atawassalu bihi ilayka fi qada'i hawa'iji,
segments.translation: "Oh Allah! The Lord of seven heavens, and the Lord of seven earths, and whatever is in them, and whatever is between them, and whatever is beneath them, and the Lord of tremendous throne.

segments.arabic: وَ رَبَّ جِبْرَآئِيْلَ وَ مِيْكَائِيْلَ وَ اِسْرَافِيْلَ وَ رَبَّ السَّبْعِ الْمَثَانِيْ وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيْمِ وَ رَبَّ مُـحَمَّدٍ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهٖ خَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Wa an tarhama Muhammadan wa Aala Muhammadin,
segments.translation: And the Lord of Gabriel, Michael and Israfeel, and the Lord of Sab-e-Masani (surah Al-Fateha), and the Lord of tremendous Quran; and the Lord of Muhammad, the l

segments.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْاَعْظَمِ الَّذِيْ بِهِ تَقُوْمُ السَّمٰوَاتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ وَ بِهٖ تُـحْيِي الْمَوْتٰى وَ تَرْزُقُ الْاَحْيَا وَ تُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ الْمُجْتَمَعِ بَيْنَ الْمُتَفَرِّقِ وَ بِهٖ اَحْصَيْتَ عَدَدَ الْآجَالِ وَ وَزْنَ الْـجِبَالِ وَ كِيْلَ الْبِحَارِ
segments.translation: I ask Thee by Thy mightiest name, by Whom heavens and earth are sustained, and by Whom the dead are given life and the living are provided with sustenance, and the gathered, and the scattered are gathered, and by Whom are encompassed the number of the spans of life, and the weight of mountains, and the measure of oceans.

segments.arabic: اَسْاَلُكَ يَا مَنْ هُوَ كَذٰلِكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَنْ تَفْعَلَ بِيْ كَذَا وَ كَذَا.
segments.translation: Oh one! Who are like this, I ask Thee to Shower unbounded blessing on Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad and do for me such and such (in the place of âsuch and suchâ ask for you need)."

segments.arabic:
---
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ وَفَكَاكَ خِيرَتِي، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمَنَا وَتَتُوبَ عَلَيْنَا وَتَتَوَفَّنَا غَيْرَ مَفْتُونِينَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: Wa birri ikhwaani, wa tamaami taa'atika,
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask you to make me do pious deeds, and that which is lawful, prevent me from ding that which is forbidden, let me do that which is good; protect us have pity on us, admit us to your mercy, and cause us to die without ever having been seduced to evil, by your mercy, O the most merciful

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، 
اَلْاَوَّلُ وَالْاٰخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُالْبَاطِنُ،
segments.translation: You are God, there is no any other deity except You, the first and the last, the apparent, the Inward,

segments.arabic:
وَاَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،

 اِلَيْكَ زِيَادَةُ الْاَشْيَاۤءِ وَنُقْصَانُهَا،
segments.translation:
You are God, there is no any other deity except You,
  unto You the increase and decrease of all things,

segments.arabic:
وَاَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 خَلَقْتَ الْخَلْقَ بِغَيْرِ مَعُوْنَةٍ مِنْ غَيْرِكَ، 
 وَلَاحَاجَةٍ اِلَيْهِمْ،
segments.translation: You are God, there is no any other deity except You, You create the creations without helping hand from other than You and You are not in need of them;

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، 
 مِنْكَ الْمَشِيَّةُ وَاِلَيْكَ الْبَدْءُ۔
segments.translation: You are God, there is no any other deity except You, all wishes from You and unto You all the initiation.

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 قَبْلَ الْقَبْلِ وَخَالِقُ الْقَبْلِ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any other deity except You, before the previous and the creator of the previous,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤاِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 بَعْدَ الْبَعْدِ وَخَالِقُ الْبَعْدِ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any deity except You, after afterward  the creator of afterward,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 تَمْحُوْ مَا تَشَاۤءُ وَتُثْبِتُ وَعِنْدَكَ اُمُّ الْكِتَابِ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any deity except You, You erase and establish what ever You wishes and with You the essence  of the Book,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ، 
 غَايَةُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَوَارِثُهُ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any other deity except You, the Goal and the Inheritor of every thing,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، 
 لَايَعْزُبُ عَنْكَ الدَّقِيْقُ وَلَا الْجَلِيْلُ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any other deity except You, both small and mighty are not far away from You,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 لَايَخْفٰى عَلَيْكَ اللُّغَاتُ، 
 وَلَاتَتَشَابَهُ عَلَيْكَ الْاَصْوَاتُ۔
segments.transliteration: walhamdu lillahi alladhi lam yattakhidh sahibatan wa laÂ waladan
segments.translation: You are God there is no any other deity except You, there is no any language hidden to You and voices are not similar to You.

segments.arabic:
كُلَّ يَوْمٍ اَنْتَ فِيْ شَاْنٍ،
 لَايَشْغَلُكَ شَاْنٌ عَنْ شَاْنٍ، 
 عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَاَخْفٰى، 
 دَيَّانُ الدِّيْنِ،
 مُدَبِّرُ الْاُمُوْرِ،
segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu sharikun fi almulki
segments.translation: Every day You are at Your duty and a duty did not disturb You from another, the Knower of all hidden and concealed things, the owner of Religion, the director of all things,

segments.arabic:
بَاعِثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُوْرِ، 
 مُحْيِ الْعِظَامِ وَهِيَ رَمِيْمٌ،
segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu waliyyun min aldhdhulli
segments.translation: He who raises those in the graves, He who gave life to bone after they have became decayed.

segments.arabic:
اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْمَكْنُوْنِ الْمَخْزُوْنِ،
 اَلْحَيِّ الْقَيُّوْمِ، 
 اَلَّذِيْ لَايَخِيْبُ مَنْ سَاَلَكَ بِهِ،
 اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهِ،
segments.translation: I requested from You by Your sheltered Name, the Eternal the Everlasting, who did not disappoint who ever call Him by His name, to send blessing on Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic:
وَاَنْ تُعَجِّلَ فَرَجَ الْمُنْتَقِمِ لَكَ مِنْ اَعْدَاۤئِكَ،
 وَاَنْجِزْلَهُ مَا وَعَدْتَهُ، 
 يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ۔
segments.translation: and hasten the reappearance of Your retaliator from Your enemies and execute for him all You have promised him, O' the possessor of Magnificence and Honour.

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ الله الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سُبْحَانَ اللهِ والْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلا إلهَ إلاَّ اللهُ واللهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلا حَوْلَ ولا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ باللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation:
âGlory be to Allah, all praise is due to Him! There is no god but Allah. 
Allah is the greatest; and there is no might and no strength but from Allah, the most superior, the All-tremendous.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالآصَالِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالإبْكَارِ فَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
segments.translation:
Glory be to Allah at morning and evening.
 Glorify His purity when you enter upon the time of evening and morning.

segments.arabic: وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّموَاتِ والأَرْضِ وَعَشِيّاً وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عمَّا يَصِفُونَ
segments.translation: And to Him belongs praise in the heavens and the earth, at night fall and mid-day.Glory be to Allah and all honour for He is free from the stories ascribed (about Him).

segments.arabic: وَسَلاَمٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be on His apostles. And all praise rightly belongs to Allah â Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْمُلْكِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ سُبْحَانَ ذِي العِزَّةِ والْجَبَرُوتِ سُبْحَان الحَيّ الَّذِي لا يَمُوتُ
segments.transliteration: wa barik li fimaÂ qasamta li
segments.translation: Glory be to possessor of the dominion and the Kingdom. Glory be to possessor of might and invincibility. Glory be to the Living, the one Who will never die.

segments.arabic:
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْقَائِمِ الدَّائِمِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْحَيِّ الْقَيُّومِ سُبْحَانَ الْعَلِيِّ الأَعْلى سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالى
 سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلائِكَةِ والرُّوحِ.
segments.transliteration: wa ballighni birahmatika kulla alladhi arju minka
segments.translation: Glory be to the All-Self-existent, the Everlasting, Glory be to the Living the Self-subsistent. Glory be to the All-high, the Most High. Glory be to Him and exalted be He, All-glory and All-holy, our Lord and the Lord of Angels and spirit.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إنّ ذَنْبِي أَمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِعَفَوِكَ وَخَوْفِي أَمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِأَمْنِكَ وَفَقْرِي أمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِغِنَاكَ وذُلّي أمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِعِزّكَ،
segments.translation: Oh Allah, surely my sin seeks the refuge of Thy pardon; and my fear seeks the refuge of Thy peace; and my indigence seeks the refuge of Thy self-sufficiency; and my abasement seeks the refuge of Thy exaltation.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ واغْفِرْ لي وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Bless Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad, and pardon me, and have mercy on me, for surely Thou art the Praised and the Glorious.

segments.arabic:
اَللَّهُمَّ تَمَّ نُورُكَ فَهَدَيْتَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَعَظُمَ حِلْمُكَ فَعَفَوْتَ 
 فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَجْهُكَ رَبَّنَا أَكْرَمُ الْوُجُوهِ وَجَاهُكَ أَعْظَمُ الْجَاهِ وَعَطِيَّتُكَ أَفْضَلُ الْعَطَايَا تُطَاعُ
segments.translation: Oh Allah! as Thy light has guided me, so all praise is due to Thee; and by the bounty of Thy clemency pardon me, so all praise is due to Thee Oh our Lord! Thou art the Most Generous of the generous and Thy Splendour is greater than all splendour, and Thy gift is greater in merit than all gifts.

segments.arabic:
ربَّنَا وَتَشْكُرُ وَتُعْصى فَتَغْفِرُ وَتُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ وَتَكْشِفُ الضُّرَّ وَتُنْجِي مِنَ الْكَرْبِ وَتُغْني الْفُقِيرَ 
 وَتَشْفي السَّقِيمَ ولا يُجَاري آلاءَكَ أَحَدٌ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.translation: Thou thank those who obey thee and forgive when disobeyed, and grants the supplication of one in distress, and removes the harm, and rescues from affliction, and enriches the indigent, and cures the ailing, and nobody can recompense for any of Thy blessings. Oh Most Merciful of the Merciful!â.
O He Who has sealed the Prophethood with Muhammad,

segments.transliteration: balligh muhammadan sallaÂ allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: Allah may bless him and his Household,

segments.arabic: إِخْتِمْ لِي فِي يَوْمِي هٰذَا بِخَيْرٍ
segments.translation: (please) seal with goodness this day of mine,
this month of mine,
this year of mine,
and my entire lifetime.

segments.transliteration: wa bimuhammadin sallaÂ allahu `alayhi wa alihi atawajjahu
segments.translation: O You Who have risen high and become great.

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `alaÂ muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: And You subdued and overcame.

segments.transliteration: waj`alni bihim `indaka wajihan fi alddunyaÂ wal-akhirati wa min almuqarrabina
segments.translation: And You overcame and subdued.
O You Who became mighty and great through Your power.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ بَسَطْتَ ظِلَّكَ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ،
segments.translation: O You Who have spread Your shadow over Your creation.
And bestowed Your blessings upon Your servants.
I ask You, O Severe in punishment.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَنْتَقِمُ بِقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْإِلْحَادِ،
segments.translation: O You Who avenges with His power against the people of disbelief.

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ وَلِيِّكَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ،
segments.translation: I ask You by the right of Your guardian, Ali ibn Abi Talib.

segments.arabic: وَأَتَوَسَّلُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ فِي قَضَاءِ حَوَائِجِي،
segments.translation: And I seek his intercession with You to fulfill my needs.
And that You have mercy on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
And help me to fulfill my needs.
And to perform my supererogatory prayers and obligations.
And to be kind to my brothers and complete in Your obedience.
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
O Allah, when You called at me, I responded to Your call,
performed the prayer prescribed by You,
and dispersed through the land as You have ordered me to do.
So, I beseech You to make me, out of Your favoring, work in obedience to You,
avoid disobedience to You,
and gain sufficient sustenance, in the name of Your mercy.
All glory be to Allah,
there is no god save Allah,

segments.arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صَاحِبَةً وَلاَ وَلَداً
segments.translation: and all praise is due to Allah, Who has not taken a wife or a son

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي ٱلْمُلْكِ
segments.translation: and Who has not a partner in the kingdom,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ
segments.translation: and Who has not a helper to save Him from disgrace;
and magnify Him with all magnificence.
I pray for Allahâs protection from Satan, the accursed.
O Allah, I am weak;
so, (please) strengthen my weakness in the course of Your pleasure,
lead my forelock to goodness,
cause faith to be the utmost of my pleasure,
bless for me that which You have decided for me,

segments.arabic: وَبَلِّغْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ كُلَّ ٱلَّذِي ارْجُو مِنْكَ
segments.translation: make me attain, by means of Your mercy, all that which I wish from You,
and appoint love for me,
delight for the believers,
and a covenant with You.
O Allah, Lord of this perfect supplication
and established prayer,

segments.arabic: بَلِّغْ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.translation: (please) assign to Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household,
the rank, right of mediation,
excellence, and advantage.
With Allah do I commence,
from Allah do I seek success,

segments.arabic: وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ اتَوَجَّهُ
segments.translation: and in the name of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, do I turn my face (towards Allah).

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِي بِهِمْ عِنْدَكَ وَجِيهاً فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
segments.translation: and, in their names, make me worthy of regard in this world and in the Hereafter, and of those drawn near to You.
And (please) admit his intercessionÂ and raise his rank.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ‏ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاِقْبَالِ نَهَارِكَ وَ اِدْبَارِ لَيْلِكَ
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-aloka be-iqbaale nahaareka wa idbaare layleka
segments.translation: O Allah! I ask You on behalf of Your morning and Your night,

segments.arabic: وَ حُضُوْرِ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَ اَصْوَاتِ دُعَآئِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa hozoore salawaateka wa aswaate do-aâaa-eka
segments.translation: and the voice of Your callers

segments.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an tosalleya aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin
segments.translation: that You send Blessings upon Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْ تَتُوْبَ عَلَيَّ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ.
segments.transliteration: wa an tatooba aâlayya innaka antat tawwaabur raheem
segments.translation: and that You forgive me as You are the Forgiver, the Merciful.
I prostrate to you in humility & abjectness
O Allah, (please) make my heart dutiful,
my actions pleasing
my livelihood delightful,
my sustenance profuse,
my childrenÂ righteous
and make for me at the tomb of Your Messenger,
may Allah bless him and his Household,
an abode and a dwelling.
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
O Allah, to You have I turned my face,
Your pleasure have I sought,
for Your reward have I desired,
in You do I believe,
and on You do I rely.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `alaÂ muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
open the ears of my hearts to remembering You,

segments.transliteration: wa thabbitni `alaÂ dinika wa dini nabiyyika
segments.translation: make me stand firmly on the religion of You and Your Prophet,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُزِغْ قَلْبِي بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: wa laÂ tuzigh qalbi ba`da idh hadaytani
segments.translation: make not my hearts to deviate after You have guided me aright,

segments.transliteration: wa hab li min ladunka rahmatan
segments.translation: and grant me from You mercy.
Surely, You are the most liberal Giver.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ هٰذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّآمَّةِ وَ الصَّلَاةِ الْقَآئِمَةِ بَلِّغْ مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهِ الدَّرَجَةَ وَ الْوَسِيْلَةَ وَ الْفَضْلَ وَ الْفَضِيلَةَ
segments.transliteration: allaahumma rabba haazehid daâwatit taam-mate was salaatil qaaa-emate balligh mohammadan sallal laaho aâlayhe wa aalehid darajata wal waseelata wal fazla wal fazeelata
segments.translation: O Allah! Lord of this perfect supplication and established prayer, assign to Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his progeny, the rank, right of mediation, excellence, and advantage.

segments.arabic: بِاللهِ اَسْتَفْتِحُ وَ بِاللهِ اَسْتَنْجِحُ وَ بِـمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَتَوَجَّهُ.
segments.transliteration: bil-laahe astafteho wa bil-laahe astanjeho wa be-mohammadin rasoolil laahe wa aale mohammadin atawajjaho.
segments.translation: With Allah do I commence, from Allah do I seek success, and in the name of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his progeny, do I turn my face (towards Allah).

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اجْعَلْنِي بِهِمْ عِنْدَكَ وَجِيْهًا فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ وَ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ.‏
segments.transliteration: allaahumma salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin waj aâlnee behim iândaka wajeehan fid dunyaa wal aakherate wa menal moqarrabeen.
segments.translation: O Allah! Send blessings upon Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad, and, in their names, make me worthy of regard in this world and in the Hereafter, and of those drawn near to You.0
O Allah, I submit Muhammad,
may Allah bless him and his Household,
to You before mentioning my needs,
and I turn to You in his name;
so, (please) make me of high regard with You
in this world and the Hereafter,
and of those drawn near to You,
and (please) decide, in his name, my prayer to be admitted,
my sin to be forgiven,
and my supplication to be responded.
You are verily the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي تَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni atawajjahu ilayka bimuhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, I turn my face towards You in the name of Muhammad and Muhammadâs Household,
present them before You before I begin my prayers,
and seek nearness to You in their names.
So, in their names, (please) make me of high regard with You
in this world and the Hereafter
and of those drawn near to You.
You have endued me with the great favor of making me know them;
so, (please) seal my life with obedience to them,
recognition of them, and loyalty to them,
because this is the true happiness.
Therefore, (please) seal my life with these things,
for You have power over all things.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْنِي مَعَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`alni ma`a muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) make me with Muhammad and Muhammadâs Household
in every item of wellbeing and tribulation

segments.transliteration: waj`alni ma`a muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: and make me with Muhammad and Muhammadâs Household
in every place of returning and place of rest.
O Allah, (please) make me live their lives
and die their death,
include me with them in all situations,

segments.transliteration: wa laÂ tufarriq bayni wa baynahum
segments.translation: and do not depart me from them.
Verily, You have power over all things.
O Allah, (please) do not make me despair of Your soothing mercy,
do not make me lose hope of Your mercy,
and do not make me feel secure against Your plans,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَامَنُ مَكْرَ ٱللَّهِ إِلاَّ ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْخَاسِرُونَ
segments.transliteration: fa'innahu laÂ ya'manu makra allahi illaÂ alqawmu alkhasiruna
segments.translation: for none feels secure against Allahâs plans except the losing people.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَ بِاللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
segments.transliteration: bismi l-lahi wa  bi l-lahi, tawa kaltu Ê¿ala l-lahi, aÊ¿Å«dhu bi l-lahi s-samÄ«Ê¿i l-Ê¿alÄ«mi mina sh-shayá¹­ÄniÂ ÄlrrajÄ«mi
segments.translation: In the Name of God and by God, I put my trust in God, I seek refuge in God, the All-hearing, the All-knowing from Satan, the Stoned One. You will exorcize him and drive him away.
O Allah, You are verily the King and the Manifest Truth.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have wronged myself;
so, (please) forgive my sin.

segments.arabic: إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ إِلاََّ انْتَ
segments.transliteration: innahu laÂ yaghfiru aldhdhunuba illaÂ anta
segments.translation: Verily, none can forgive sins save You.
Here I am responding to You and here I am trying to please You.
All goodness is at Your Hand.
Evil is never ascribed to You.
A true guided is he whom You guide.
I, Your servant and the son of Your two servants,
am standing in submission before You,

segments.transliteration: minka wa bika wa laka wa ilayka
segments.translation: and I am from You, through You, to You, and for You.
There is neither haven nor shelter

segments.transliteration: wa laÂ mafarra minka illaÂ ilayka
segments.translation: nor escape from You except with You.
All glory be to You; I am seeking Your kindness.
Blessed You are and Exalted You are.
All glory be to You, O Lord of the Sacred House.

segments.arabic: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلارْضَ
segments.transliteration: wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhi fatara alssamawati wal-arda
segments.translation: I have turned myself to Him Who originated the heavens and the earth,
the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed,
[and I am] upright and Muslim
and I am not of the polytheists.
Surely, my prayer, my sacrifice,
my life, and my death
are (all) for Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
No associate has He;
and this am I commanded,
and I am of those who submit.

segments.arabic: «إِيمَانِي بِأُمَّةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَدِينِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَمَسَارِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، وَأُصَلِّي صَلَاتِي بِقَبُولِ قِيَادَةِ ذُرِّيَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَأَنَا أَعْبُدُ وَأَسْتَسْلِمُ لِلَّهِ دُونَ أَنْ أَنْسِبَ لَهُ شَرِيكاً»
segments.transliteration: ('iimani bi'umat 'iibrahim wadin muhamad wamasar ealii bn 'abi talib , wa'usaliy salaati biqabul qiadat dhariyat muhamad , wa'ana 'aebud wa'astaslim lilah dun 'an 'unsib lah shrykaan).
segments.translation: (I have faith upon the nation of Ibrahim and the religion of Mohammad and the path of Ali bin Abi Talib, and I offer my prayers accepting the leadership of Mohammadâs Progeny, while I worship and surrender before Allah, without ascribing any partner to Him).

segments.arabic: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذي فَطَرَ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنيفاً مُسْلِماً عَلى مِلَّةِ إِبْراهيمَ وَدينِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُدى أَميرِالْمُؤْمِنينَ وَما أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكينَ ،
segments.transliteration: wa jahtu wajhiya li l-ladhÄ« faá¹­ara s-samÄwÄti wa l-ará¸a á¸¥anÄ«fÄan muslimÄan Ê¿ala millati ibrÄhÄ«ma wa dÄ«ni Muá¸¥ammadin wa hud amÄ«riÄlmu'minÄ«na wa mÄ anÄ mina l-mushrikÄ«na ,
segments.translation: I have directed my face towards the one who created the Heavens and the Earth while I am a worshipper who surrenders before Him,   I have faith upon the nation of Ibrahim and the religion of Mohammad and the guidance of the Commander of the faithful,

segments.arabic: إِنَّ صَلاتي وَنُسُكي وَمَحْيايَ وَمَماتي للَّهِِ رَبِّ الْعالَمينَ،

segments.transliteration: lÄ sharÄ«ka lahu wa bi dhlika umirtu wa anÄ mina l-muslimÄ«n.
segments.translation: No partner has He, and this I have been commanded, and I am the first (among You) of the Muslims.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْني مِنَ الْمُسْلِمينَ ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّميعِ الْعَليمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ الرَّجيمِ ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحيمِ .

segments.translation: Oâ Allah, regard me among the Muslims, I seek refuge in Allah, the Hearer, the Knower, from Satan, the expelled, in the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.â
I pray Allahâs protection from Satan, the accursed.
All praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
Such is Allah my Lord, or.
Such is Allah our Lord.
All glory be to my Lord, the All-great, and in praise of Him.
May Allah listen to him who praises Him.

segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allahu rabbi wa atubu ilayhi
segments.translation: I implore Allah, my Lord, for forgiveness and I repent to Him.

segments.transliteration: bihawli allah wa quwwatihi aqumu wa aq`udu
segments.translation: With the might of Allah and with His power, I stand up and sit down.
Such is Allah, my Lord.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَ بِاللهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَ خَیْـرُ الْأَسْمَاءِ لِلّٰهِ
segments.transliteration: bismil lÄhi wa billÄhi wal á¸¥amdu lillÄhi wa khayrul asmÄÊ¾i lillÄh
segments.translation: In the name of Allah and by Allah. All praise is for Allah and the best names belong to Allah.

segments.arabic: وَ تَـقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ وَ ارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa taqabbal shafÄÊ¿atahu war faÊ¿ darajatah<
segments.translation: I seek forgiveness of Allah my Lord and I turn to HimÂ

segments.arabic: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّهَ رَبِّي وَ اَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ.
segments.translation: O Allah! Forgive me.
O the Best of those who are Asked, and O the Best Giver! Grant me sustenance and grant my family sustenance with Your grace, for indeed, You are the Possessor of Great Grace;

segments.arabic: یَا خَیْـرَ الْمَسْـــــــئُولِینَ وَ یَا خـَـــیْـرَ الْمُعْطِینَ، اُرْزُقْنِي وَ ارْزُقْ عِیَاِلي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، فَإِنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِیمِ
segments.transliteration: yÄ khayral masÊ¾Å«lÄ«n wa yÄ khayral muÊ¿á¹­Ä«n, urzuqnÄ« war zuq Ê¿iyÄlÄ« min faá¸lik, faÊ¾innaka dhÅ«l faá¸lil Ê¿aáºÄ«m
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah (I begin) and in Allah (I trust).
All praise be to Allah.
The most excellent names be to Allah.
I bear witness that there is no god save Allah.

segments.arabic: اشْهَدُ انْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ اللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: O Allah, to You alone have I genuflected,
to You alone have I submitted,
in You have I believed,
and in You have I put my trust.
And You are my Lord.
Revering to You are my hearing, my sight,
my hair, my skin,
my flesh, my blood,
my brain, my nerve, my bones,
and whatever is borne by my two feet.
I am neither disdaining, nor arrogant, nor regretful.

segments.arabic: غَيْرَ مُسْتَنْكِفٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَكْبِرٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَحْسِرٍ
segments.transliteration: ghayra mustankifin wa la mustakbirin wa la mustahsir
segments.translation: O Allah, to You (alone) do I prostrate,
in You do I have faith,
to You do I submit,
in You do I put trust,
and You are my Lord.
My face is prostrating the One Who has created it
and split its hearing and sight.
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
Blessed be Allah, the most excellent of all creators.
O Allah, (please) forgive us, have mercy upon us,
endue us with wellbeing, and pardon us
in this world and in the Hereafter.
Verily, You have power over all things.
O Allah, if there is any one who begins his day by putting his trust and his hope in any one other than

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ كَانَ اصْبَحَ وَلَهُ ثِقَةٌ اوْ رَجَاءٌ غَيْرُكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma man kana asbaha wa lahu thiqatun aw raja'un ghayruka
segments.translation: then You (alone) is my trust and my hope.
O most magnanimous of all those who may be besought!
O most merciful of all those whose mercy may be prayed!
(Please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
have mercy upon my weakness, neediness,
and lack of solution,
bestow upon me with Paradise out of Your favoring,
set my neck free from Hellfire,
and endue me with wellbeing in my self
and in all of my affairs,
in the name of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy
There is none worth worshipping but Allah Who is Forbearing and Generous

segments.arabic: لآ اِلَهَ اِلاَّ اللّهُ الْحَلِيْمُ الْكَرِيْمُ
segments.translation: There is none worth worshipping but Allah Who is Most High and

segments.arabic: لآ اِلَهَ اِلاَّ اللّهُ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, Who is the Sustainer of the seven heavens and of the seven earth
And Who is the Sustainer of all the things
in them, and between them,

segments.arabic: وَ مَا فِيْهِنَّ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ وَ
segments.transliteration: wa maa fihinna wa maa baynahunna
segments.translation: And Who is the Lord of the great âArsh
And all praise for Allah, the Sustainer of the worlds.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You to send blessings upon Muhammad
the Prophet of Your mercy and the Word of Your Light,

segments.transliteration: wa an tamla'a qalbi nura alyaqini
segments.translation: and to fill in my heart with the illumination of certitude,
my chest with the illumination of faith,
my intellect with the illumination of honest intentions,
my determination with the illumination of knowledge,
my strength with the illumination of work,
my tongue with the illumination of honesty,
my religion with the illumination of clear evidence from You,
my sight with the illumination of brightness,
my hearing with the illumination of wisdom,

segments.transliteration: wa mawaddati nura almuwalati limuhammadin wa alihi
segments.translation: and my faculty of love with the illumination of sincere loyalty to Muhammad and his Household,
peace be upon them,

segments.arabic: حَتَّىٰ أَلْقَاكَ وَقَدْ وَفَيْتُ بِعَهْدِكَ وَمِيثَاقِكَ
segments.transliteration: hatta alqaka wa qad wafaytu bi`ahdika wa mithaqika
segments.translation: so that I, when I meet You, will have fulfilled the pledge and covenant that I made with You
and then Your mercy will encompass me.
O Protector! O Worthy of all praise!
O Allah, bless Muhammad (al-Mahdi)
Your argument in Your land,
Your viceroy in Your countries,
the caller to Your course,
the establisher of Your justice,
the revolting by Your command,
the authority of the believers,
the ruiner of the unbelievers,
the remover of the murk,
the illuminator of the truth,
the speaker with wisdom and honesty,
the perfect Word of You in Your lands,
the vigilant and fearful,
the well-wishing saint,
the ark of salvation,
the sign of guidance,
the light of the peoplesâ sights,

segments.transliteration: wa khayri man taqammasa wa irtada
segments.translation: the best of all those who put clothes on their bodies,
and the unveiler of blindness,
who will fill the lands with justice and equity
as it would be filled up with wrong and unfairness.
You verily have power over all things.
O Allah, bless Your vicegerent
and the son of Your vicegerents the obedience to whom You have made incumbent upon us
and the observance of the right of whom You have made obligatory
and from whom You have removed filth
and whom You have purified with thorough purifying.
O Allah, give him victory and make him the supporter of Your religion
and through him, give victory to Your and his adherents,
followers, and backers.
Include us with them.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ بَاغٍ وَطَاغٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma a`idhhu min sharri kulli baghin wa taghin
segments.translation: O Allah, protect him against the evil of every transgressor and tyrant
and against the evils of all Your creatures.

segments.arabic: وَٱحْفَظْهُ مِنْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ
segments.transliteration: wahfazhu min bayni yadayhi wa min khalfihi
segments.translation: Guard him from ahead of him, behind him,
his right side, and his left side.

segments.arabic: وَٱحْرُسْهُ وَٱمْنَعْهُ مِنْ أَنْ يوُصَلَ إِلَيْهِ بِسُوءٍ
segments.transliteration: wahrus-hu wamna`hu min an yusala ilayhi bisu'in
segments.translation: Watch him and defend him against anything that may cause evil to him.

segments.transliteration: wahfaz fihi rasulaka wa ala rasulika
segments.translation: Save through him Your Messenger and the family of Your Messenger.
Manifest justice through him.
Aid him with victory.
Help his backers.
Frustrate those who intend to disappoint him.
Terminate those who intend to eradicate him.
And, through him, terminate the tyrants of unbelief,
kill the disbelievers, the hypocrites,
and all atheists,

segments.arabic: حَيْثُ كَانُوٱ مِنْ مَشَارِقِ ٱلأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا
segments.transliteration: haythu kanu min mashariqi al-ardi wa magharibiha
segments.translation: wherever they are; in the east or the west of the earth
on the lands or in the oceans,
and, through him, fill in the earth with justice,
manifest the religion of Your Prophet,

segments.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa sallama
segments.translation: blessings and peace of You be upon him and his Household,

segments.transliteration: waj`alni allahumma min ansarihi wa a`wanihi
segments.translation: make me, O Allah, of his supporters, helpers,
followers, and adherents;

segments.arabic: وَأَرِنِي فِي آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ مَا يَأْمُلُونَ
segments.transliteration: wa arini fi ali muhammadin `alayhim alssalamu ma ya'muluna
segments.translation: allow me to see the hopes of the family of Muhammad, peace be upon them, come true,
and the hazards of their enemies come true.
O God of Truth, respond.
O Lord of Glory and Honor!
O most merciful of those who show mercy!
